coordinateSummary.warning: All newly created positions are development-stage corridor reconciliations. They must be replaced with exact authoritative stop coordinates without changing composite IDs.

topologyDecisions: Line 014 is stored as two independently ordered open patterns: Finestrat Pueblo to Salto del Agua and the published return direction.
Line 015 is stored as two independently ordered open patterns: Hotel Bali to Finestrat Pueblo and the published return direction.
All four patterns use closesLoop false; no reverse sequence or last-to-first edge is inferred.
The bracketed public title of Line 015 is preserved, but no separate branch pattern is invented because the official route page publishes one complete ordered list for each direction.
Shared terminal StopNodes may end one pattern and begin the opposite pattern without converting the pair into a closed cycle.
The repeated FIN 672 occurrence across both routes and directions is the same stable identity and is not duplicated route-specifically.
identityDecisions: All accepted shared objects are copied exactly from prior Benidorm scenarios.
FIN 606 and FIN 607 remain distinct directional CV-767 identities.
FIN 619 and FIN 627 remain distinct directional Golf Bahía identities.
FIN 621/625 and FIN 622/624 remain distinct directional Cantareria and Font Carrec identities.
FIN 636 and FIN 637 remain distinct directional commercial-center identities.
BND 185 and BND 189 remain distinct Terra Natura directional identities and are reused exactly from the accepted attractions scenario.
Every new StopNode receives a singleton StopPlace; similar names and proximity do not merge identities.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
